description: Add .editorconfig for consistent formatting across all editors and reformat minified CSS in xiaod-media-transcriber and project-progress-board
steps: Create `.editorconfig` at repo root with: root=true, indent_style=space, indent_size=2, end_of_line=lf, charset=utf-8, trim_trailing_whitespace=true, insert_final_newline=true, max_line_length for .md files
Reformat `apps/xiaod-media-transcriber/public/styles.css` (13 lines minified) to human-readable multi-line CSS with proper indentation. Keep all rules identical, just format them properly.
Reformat `apps/project-progress-board/public/styles.css` (24 lines minified) to human-readable multi-line CSS with proper indentation. Keep all rules identical, just format them properly.
Rebuild both frontends to ensure public JS files are not affected: `npm run build:frontend --workspace=media-transcriber-agent` and `npm run build:frontend --workspace=project-progress-board`
acceptance_criteria: .editorconfig exists at repo root with reasonable defaults
No logic changes to any CSS - same selectors, same properties, same values
verification: Visually inspect formatted CSS files for readability
findings: Pre-existing check:architecture failure (repository-catalog.json area validation) unrelated to CSS changes. All workspace checks and frontend builds pass successfully.
